items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: And he found out that they needed a drummer, so he recommended me.

ctx.x: And he found out that they needed a drummer, so he recommended me. So they called me at the house, and after the job, Dan Murphy and his Skippers (that's the name of his band) were eating in an all night restaurant, and they called my house to come down and meet him.
